title: My First Job Interview
author: Léxi
desc: Se présenter, parler de ses qualités et poser des questions en entretien.

p: Yao has an interview with a hotel in Abidjan. The manager is from Nigeria, so the interview is in English.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Yao. Please have a seat."
"Good afternoon. Thank you for inviting me."
"My name is Yao Kouadio. I'm twenty-three years old. I studied tourism at the university. Last year, I did an internship of six months in a hotel in Assinie. I worked at the reception."
"Very good. Why do you want to work here?"
"Your hotel is one of the best in Abidjan. I want to learn from the best. And I love meeting people from other countries."
"I'm organised and I'm patient. I stay calm when there are problems. And I speak French, English and a little Spanish."
Yao thinks for a second. "Sometimes I work too much on details. But I'm learning to manage my time better."
The manager smiles. "Good answer. Do you have any questions for me?"
"Yes. What does a typical day look like in this job? And are there training opportunities?"
"Excellent questions. We have training every month. We'll call you before Friday."
"Thank you very much for your time. Have a nice day."

*Thank you for inviting me.* — Merci de m'avoir invité.
*I studied … at …* — J'ai étudié … à …
*I have experience in …* — J'ai de l'expérience en …
*I'm organised / hard-working / a fast learner.* — Je suis organisé / travailleur / j'apprends vite.
*Why do you want this job?* — Pourquoi voulez-vous ce poste ?
*Do you have any questions?* — Avez-vous des questions ?
*When will I hear from you?* — Quand aurai-je une réponse ?
Practise: write your own answer to "Tell me about yourself" in five sentences. Then say it out loud.
